name: Crier
source:
A performer at the Revue moving amusement park.
A tsundere. He was tough on the newcomer protagonist, but he's good at looking after people even if they complain.
He has a complex about his short height and often pokes at the tall [url=/c83807]Serge[/url].
He's the only member of the staff that can leave the Revue.

Hobby: Magic tricks
